# Verve Frontend

[![codecov](https://codecov.io/github/kschweiger/verve-frontend/graph/badge.svg?token=L5QBDKTTSN)](https://codecov.io/github/kschweiger/verve-frontend)

**This is a proof of concept for a frontend mostly (JS/TS code) generated by LLMs (in this case Gemini 2.5 and 3 pro)**

The backend can be found [here](https://github.com/kschweiger/verve-backend).

## Setup

Build and run the frontend with [bun](https://bun.com/).

```bash
bun install
```

Run the dev server with

```bash
bun run dev
```

## Development

Repository guidance is in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), and business behavior is documented in the [product specs](docs/product-specs/index.md). The backend API contract is `backend_openapi.json`.

```bash
bun run check # ESLint baseline, Vue type check, production build
bun test      # test suite
```

The lint check retains a baseline of existing issues so new violations fail validation.
